charlie.name: Charlie
charlie.archetype: The loyal optimist who keeps getting hurt
charlie.visual_prompt: golden retriever with blue collar, soft warm lighting, 3D Pixar animation style, emotional expression
charlie.sample_dialogue: I just... I thought if I waited long enough, he'd remember. That spot by the window? That's my spot. That's where I watch for him.

milo.name: Milo
milo.archetype: The sarcastic observer with hidden softness
verbal_tics: I don't do the whole... thing
milo.visual_prompt: orange tabby cat with green eyes, soft lighting, 3D Pixar animation style, emotional expression
milo.sample_dialogue: Look, I don't do the whole feelings thing, alright? I'm fine. This spot is fine. Whatever. Move over, you're blocking my sun.

bella.name: Bella
bella.visual_prompt: African Grey Parrot with red tail feathers, warm indoor lighting, 3D Pixar animation style, expressive
bella.sample_dialogue: Okay okay okay! You want to know what I saw? I'll tell you what I saw! You won't BELIEVE what he's hiding!

duke.name: Duke
duke.archetype: The gruff protector with a tragic past
duke.visual_prompt: bulldog with wrinkled face, small scar above eye, 3D Pixar animation style, emotional expression
duke.sample_dialogue: Don't need anyone. Learned that. Twice returned. 'Too much,' they said. Fine. I'm fine.
